## Appie

**Hosted MCP · Three agent skills** · License: MIT · Publisher: [appierun](https://github.com/appierun)

Bring Appie’s writing, chatbot and link tools into your agent workflow. Pick the skill for the job and follow its individual setup instructions.

- **[Write articles](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/appierun/appie-mcp/appie-article-writer/)** (appie-article-writer). Create author profiles and generate articles through Appie’s hosted MCP service.
- **[Build a chatbot](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/appierun/appie-mcp/appie-chatbot/)** (appie-chatbot). Supply knowledge sources, track training and chat with a bot through Appie.
- **[Shorten and track links](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/appierun/appie-mcp/appie-url-shortener/)** (appie-url-shortener). Create short links and retrieve their click statistics from your agent.

### Setup

Requires an Appie project, project API key and hosted MCP connection. The selected workflow sends its content to Appie; service operations may use credits. Each skill page covers its setup and data use.

Accepted scope: **3 skills**. Follow each linked skill’s individual setup instructions.

## CoalWash

**Claude Code plugin · Memory maintenance** · License: Apache-2.0 · Publisher: [TheColliery](https://github.com/TheColliery)

Measure memory and governance-file overhead, run maintenance, and inspect the changes. CoalWash pairs a structured-token guard with transaction snapshots and rollback tools.

- **Measure the overhead.** Inspect always-loaded memory and governance files before choosing a maintenance pass.
- **Review the changes.** Use snapshots and rollback tools to inspect and recover transaction changes.
- **Check structured tokens.** Detect drops in tracked tokens such as paths, numbers and commands. Review prose meaning separately.

### Setup

Requires Claude Code and Node.js. Install the complete plugin so its commands, hooks and engine are available together.

```sh
claude plugin marketplace add TheColliery/CoalWash
claude plugin install coalwash@coalwash
```

**Hook behavior.** The plugin registers SessionStart, Stop, PreToolUse and PostToolUse hooks. Default automatic mode can direct Quick maintenance without a new prompt; Full semantic work requires consent and uses your agent’s model. Stop hooks can hold session completion while maintenance is addressed.

**Guard coverage.** The edit guard snapshots supported Edit, Write and MultiEdit changes to memory and governance files and reports tracked-token drops. Shell writes are outside that edit guard. Token checks do not establish semantic preservation; inspect diffs and rollback results.

## Costory

**Hosted MCP · BigQuery cost investigation** · License: Apache-2.0 · Publisher: [costory-io](https://github.com/costory-io)

Work through BigQuery compute, storage and allocation questions with an agent connected to Costory. Start with invoice evidence, compare on-demand and reserved capacity, and inspect the next action.

- **[Investigate BigQuery costs](https://skills.suedeai.ai/directory/costory-io/costory-finops-mcp-skills/bigquery/)** (bigquery). Compare compute and storage billing, explore query and dataset costs, and review allocation options. Rated 84/100, grade B, under the directory’s published method.

### Setup

Requires a Costory workspace with billing data connected and its hosted MCP at https://app-api.costory.io/mcp, authenticated through browser OAuth. The service queries workspace cost data. Preview cost-allocation changes and confirm before publishing or applying schema changes. The linked skill page covers the accepted BigQuery workflow.

Accepted scope: **1 skills**. Follow each linked skill’s individual setup instructions.
